title: Counter-Strike 2
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M-series), engine sikarugir-10.0_6, Highball 0.7.3
notes: Use DXVK: main menu, login and store all render (verified 2026-08-25; menu-level check, no match played). DXMT 0.80 gave a black screen on our macOS 14 test machine (game runs, never paints); DXMT generally wants macOS 15 or newer, so on 14 use DXVK. No NVAPI error on Highball 0.7.3+, bottles identify as an AMD card. Legacy CS:GO is now its own free Steam app — see the csgo-legacy entry (appid 4465480) for its status, including the macOS 26 map-load freeze tracked in issue #21. History of the legacy gates, for anyone on an old Highball: 'Failed to initialize NVAPI (0xFFFFFFFE)' means pre-0.7.3 (update, then Repair the bottle); 'graphics hardware does not support all features (CSM)' means DXVK's Direct3D 9 is not loading — fixed for the DXVK renderer in 0.7.8 and for every renderer in 0.7.17 (this second gap was found 2026-08-30, updating fixes it). Correction to earlier versions of this entry: the map-load freeze was previously attributed here to async shader compilation (0.7.10) — that was wrong; logs later proved the freeze occurs with async off and under every sync mode. The freeze is macOS-26-specific and remains open in issue #21.

anticheat.note: anti-cheat present; Linux/Proton support does not extend to macOS — userspace path works for some titles
